analysis.title: DeskTalk - US equity check: Back on script
key_insights: Equities rebounded sharply after a modest selloff on Tuesday that followed a hotter-than-expected CPI print and Fed Vice Chair Bowman's warning of 'a large correction in equity valuations' tied to AI-related returns. The rebound was driven by renewed AI optimism.
CoreWeave rose 26% on a beat-and-raise: 168% YoY revenue growth, margin expansion and higher guidance. Investor focus has moved back to the AI demand story.

Citi AI Research Head Heath Terry says demand is not the question. The debate is whether enough capacity can be built. If it is, the main beneficiaries remain the Hyperscalers and infrastructure providers such as CoreWeave and the major NeoClouds.
The NDX is up 7% from Thursday's low and 2.7% today. It has reclaimed the 200dma at 28,017 and last Thursday's high of 28,437 (ref $28,480).
SPX is up 1.23%. The level to watch into the close is $7,676 (ref $7,639). A close above it would trigger systematic strategies to flip long and set up buying flows on Thursday.

The SOX is on track for its best day since July, up more than 7%. Last week's pullback put the Hyperscalers vs Semis trade back in focus. Citi TMT specialist Jon Zauderer noted on 11/08 that conviction is low, but investors have favored Hyperscalers over Semis in the near term.
Options positioning across the average stock in Citi's Semis basket (CGUSSEMI) shows 1M normalized put skew has steepened less than call skew.
Cisco and Applied Materials report Thursday. Their commentary on AI-related demand and enterprise spending will be watched for confirmation that the AI investment cycle remains intact.

Conviction is low. Investors have favored Hyperscalers over Semis in the near term, even though the SOX is up more than 7% today.

earnings_insights: CoreWeave reported this session: beat-and-raise with 168% YoY revenue growth, margin expansion and higher guidance. The stock rose 26%. The report does not state whether figures are GAAP or adjusted, or give consensus numbers.
Cisco and Applied Materials are scheduled to report Thursday. No estimates are given. Their commentary on AI-related demand and enterprise spending is the focus.

tension_points.bull_case: Demand is not the question per Citi's Heath Terry. CoreWeave's beat-and-raise (168% YoY revenue growth, margin expansion, higher guidance) renewed AI optimism. NDX is up 7% from Thursday's low.
